description: Circular build arc in a vertical plane, R = 500 m, I 0°→90° at azimuth 0°, 2 stations. N = R(1−cosθ), TVD = R·sinθ, θ = MD/R; DLS = 90°/L·30 m.
tolerance_justification: Closed-form oracle. Positions are O(1e3) m, so one float64 ulp is ~1e-13 m; cumulative sums over ≤10 courses accumulate ≤~1e-12 m. 1e-11 m absolute (+1e-13 relative) is ~10x that bound. For DLS (deg/30m, O(1)) the same numbers are ~1e-14 deg/30m, far inside the tolerance.
